title: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
author: Raze
summary: Find tokens, beetles and chests on both maps. Track your first token, filter chests by progression, reveal Unmoored locations when ready, and customize marker artwork, colours, size and height arrows.

required_mods.name: REFramework
required_mods.notes: Required. Install REFramework for Dragon's Dogma 2 before this mod.

main_file.name: Map Markers and Collectables by Raze
main_file.description: v1.4: refreshed chest data, saved collection tracking, automatic progression/Unmoored filtering, customizable chest icons and colors, a red first-token marker, and map overlap/cave fog fixes. Requires REFramework. Install the complete ZIP.
